description: Free, no key, no wallet: quote any pair on Elysium across five routers (Uniswap, KyberSwap, LI.FI, Nordstern and 0x) without building a transaction. Returns the best amount out, already net of the Trnch fee, the router and the fee rate in basis points (feeBps). Native HYPE is the zero address. A transaction (trnch_buy, trnch_sell) needs an API key.

amountIn.description: Amount of tokenIn in its smallest unit (wei-style integer string).

decimalsIn.description: Decimals of tokenIn. Default 18: set it for USDC (6) and other non-18 tokens.

decimalsOut.description: Decimals of tokenOut. Default 18: set it for USDC (6) and other non-18 tokens.

fast.description: Return the first clean quote after about 250 ms instead of waiting for the best price. Default false.

slippage.description: Max slippage as a fraction (0.01 = 1%). Default 0.01.

tokenIn.description: Token sold: an Elysium token address, or the zero address for HYPE.

tokenOut.description: Token bought: an Elysium token address, or the zero address for HYPE.

name: trnch_quote
title: Quote a swap
